_comment: Tommy Mini Program isolation ESLint config (legacy .eslintrc JSON format).
_usage: Merge the `overrides` block into the addon repos' .eslintrc, or `extends` this file. The `overrides[].files` globs target addon source only — the shell/core are intentionally exempt. Land as `warn` (Phase 6 M0). Class A rules with zero existing violations flip to `error` immediately; the ~987-deep-import baseline stays `warn` + block-on-increase (see 06-instrumentation/detectors-in-ci.md) until its count reaches zero — do NOT flip it to `error` on a calendar date.

overrides._scope: Addon source — tommy-sdk-private/addons/* and tommy-sdk/addons/* (legacy development/+production/ trees AND the migrated single-tree src/ layout)

patterns.message: no-cross-addon-import (audit 1.1): Mini Programs must not import each other directly. Communicate via the Actions bus (tommy.actions.*). Inter-MP calls are manifest-mediated.

no-core-internal-import (audit 1.4): import only from the published '@tommy/sdk' entry point, never from tommy-core/src/* internals. Deep paths have no stability contract and break silently on rename.
no-escape-addon-root (audit 1.1/1.4): relative imports must not climb out of this addon's own src/ root.

no-restricted-globals.name: tommy
no-restricted-globals.message: no-ambient-tommy (audit 1.2): do not reach window.tommy. Use the injected SDK instance passed to the addon factory.

no-restricted-globals.name: __store__
no-restricted-globals.message: no-ambient-store (audit 1.2): window.__store__ is a dev-only global; addons must not touch the shell's Vuex store.

no-restricted-properties.message: no-ambient-tommy (audit 1.2/1.5): window.tommy exposes the store, event bus and api ambiently. Use the scoped SDK surface.
no-ambient-i18n (audit 1.2): use the SDK-provided i18n, not the shared window.i18n singleton.
no-ambient-moment (audit 1.2): import a local date library; window.moment is a shared mutable singleton.
no-ambient-storage (audit 1.8): addons must not read localStorage directly (token/account_id/device_id leak ambiently). Use per-MP IndexedDB and the capability token from the handshake.
no-ambient-storage (audit 1.8): addons must not write the shared localStorage. Use per-MP IndexedDB.

no-restricted-syntax.message: no-shared-event-bus (audit 1.5): the dush events bus delivers synchronously across MP boundaries. Use tommy.actions.emit / tommy.actions.subscribe (async fan-out).
no-global-dom-query (audit 1.3): addons share the DOM with the shell. Scope queries to the addon root (this.$el) — global selectors collide across MPs.
no-document-body-mutation (audit 1.3): do not append to document.body. Render inside the addon's own subtree.
no-global-listener (audit 1.3): window-level listeners are un-namespaced and leak across MPs. Scope listeners to the addon root and remove them on unmount.
